source_gap_claims.behavior: Reject a target that is a file or otherwise not a directory, rather than merely classifying it under a generic illegal-target condition.
source_gap_claims.reason: The atomic register identifies non-directory targets as an independently observable FR-1 case, but no obligation explicitly requires this behavior.
source_gap_claims.subject: Non-directory target handling

source_gap_claims.behavior: Reject a policy that removes the irreducible VDD or Acceptance package routes.
source_gap_claims.reason: Route availability obligations preserve the routes, but do not independently require rejection of a reduced minimum supported route set.
source_gap_claims.subject: Minimum supported route set

source_gap_claims.behavior: Fail closed when the validator capability is missing, substituted, or escaping its approved root.
source_gap_claims.reason: The source defines these validator-specific failure cases independently; the obligation set has no dedicated missing-validator, substituted-validator, or escaping-validator behavior.
source_gap_claims.subject: Validator capability boundary failures

source_gap_claims.behavior: Require a detached negative Probe to fail for its declared defect and expected diagnostic category, while distinguishing infrastructure failure from validation failure.
source_gap_claims.reason: The obligations require negative Probe execution and generic failure handling, but do not independently require the declared diagnostic-category match.
source_gap_claims.subject: Negative Probe diagnostic discrimination

source_gap_claims.behavior: Reject a replay when the historical replay binding identities do not match the replay inputs.
source_gap_claims.reason: The atomic register treats replay-binding identity mismatch as its own FR-5 rejection case, absent from the proposed obligations.
source_gap_claims.subject: Historical replay binding

source_gap_claims.behavior: Reject a claimed historical wrapper replay when the original wrapper was not actually launched.
source_gap_claims.reason: The source specifies a distinct no-launch failure witness, but no obligation explicitly checks wrapper launch occurrence.
source_gap_claims.subject: Historical wrapper execution

source_gap_claims.behavior: Record and validate the historical validator reference as auditable evidence.
source_gap_claims.reason: The source includes a separate historical-validator identity duty; native command identity and general evidence preservation do not independently represent it.
source_gap_claims.subject: Historical validator identity

source_gap_claims.behavior: Reject a retained evaluation seed when its applicability metadata is absent or false.
source_gap_claims.reason: The seed obligations combine several metadata requirements into one unit and do not independently represent applicability validation.
source_gap_claims.subject: Evaluation-seed applicability

source_gap_claims.behavior: Reject a retained evaluation seed when its missing-label metadata is absent.
source_gap_claims.reason: Missing-label presence is an independently observable seed requirement not represented by a dedicated obligation.
source_gap_claims.subject: Evaluation-seed missing labels

source_gap_claims.behavior: Reject a retained evaluation seed when neither a counterexample nor an explicit absence is recorded.
source_gap_claims.reason: Counterexample-or-explicit-absence is an independent source behavior merged into the broader seed-record obligations.
source_gap_claims.subject: Evaluation-seed counterexample status

source_gap_claims.behavior: Reject writes to installed BMAD and GDS skill paths.
source_gap_claims.reason: The canonical SM-6 contract preserves these protected-path hard stops, but no proposed obligation covers them.
source_gap_claims.subject: Installed BMAD/GDS protected paths

source_gap_claims.behavior: Reject writes affecting Phase service, runtime, Hosted workspace, account, or user-sandbox boundaries.
source_gap_claims.reason: These retained A16 boundary duties are independently observable and absent from the proposed obligation set.
source_gap_claims.subject: Phase and user-sandbox boundaries

source_gap_claims.behavior: Reject TC-E0 and TC-D2 through TC-D6 implementation scope within TC-D1.
source_gap_claims.reason: Roadmap separation is a distinct guardrail in the canonical contract and is not represented by the listed TC-D1 tree or quality-baseline boundaries.
source_gap_claims.subject: Roadmap scope separation

source_gap_claims.behavior: Reject promotion of seeds, packages, or Skill versions into baseline or evaluation-set authority.
source_gap_claims.reason: The canonical guardrails separately prohibit promotion; the proposed obligations only cover evaluation-seed classification and evaluation-set admission.
source_gap_claims.subject: Promotion prohibition

source_gap_claims.behavior: Reject Miner, Curator, autonomous Skill modification, ranking, and reinforcement-learning features.
source_gap_claims.reason: These are explicit non-goal guardrails in the canonical SM-6 payload with no corresponding obligations.
source_gap_claims.subject: Excluded autonomous and ranking features

source_gap_claims.behavior: Reject historical Acceptance or Q8 state as sufficient authorization for a new acceptance decision.
source_gap_claims.reason: The authority contract explicitly excludes historical Acceptance and Q8 from satisfying a new decision, but no obligation states that rejection independently.
source_gap_claims.subject: Historical lifecycle-state rejection
